**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

There is no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant binding Northwind anywhere in the Agreement. Searches for the standard triggers ("solicit", "induce", "employ or engage", "hire", "recruit") returned nothing operative, and the likely locations — § 12 (Customer Responsibilities), § 16 (Confidentiality) and § 30 (General) — contain no such restriction.

Section 12.3 goes further in our favour, expressly confirming that Customer "has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment" and preserving our right to hire anyone responding to general recruitment. That satisfies the playbook's **preferred** position (no non-solicit on Customer), so we are not at the fallback and no narrowing edits are needed.

For completeness: § 12.4 restricts Vendor from developing a directly competing analytics service during the term. That runs one way in our favour and is not flagged under this rule.
